yarn-troppo.meaning: Facts survive, with many elaborations: "a whole 23 seconds in" (correct inference), "playing with other people's money" and "their skin in the game" (colour). Some additions shift claims: "so the network's backing its own gear" is a new and unclear claim; "running ciphernodes they only half own" narrows 'partially-owned'; "get a shot at network duties" weakens 'become eligible'.
yarn-troppo.sense: Mostly fits ("cop penalties", "a cut of the fees", "quick off the mark", "flicked the switch", "tick of approval"), but "Applications put their hand up for Encrypted Execution Environments" and "so the network's backing its own gear" strain, and "they're all tangled up with each other" suggests a mess where the original means 'interlocked'.
yarn-troppo.authenticity: Plenty of real idiom ("sing out", "get stuck into", "quick off the mark", "muck it up", "dosh on the line"), but stacked tour-guide tags feel performed: "Righto, the big picture first.", "Now for the good bit.", "Here's how it worked.", "Stuck? Need a hand?"
yarn-troppo.register: Far heavier than level 2: a technical FAQ turned chatty walkthrough with added asides throughout ("And somebody was quick off the mark.", "Just don't mix it up with Network Alpha.", "The gate could open, so to speak").
yarn-troppo.tone: The neutral documentation voice turns breezy and salesy: "Now for the good bit.", "Good news: operating a ciphernode is designed to be permissionless". Facts still clear, but the tone shifts.
yarn-troppo.flow: Readable but busy, with tags interrupting the content: "The gate could open, so to speak, at or after Aug 19 at **14:00 UTC (10 AM ET)**: that's when general FOLD transferability could be enabled." repeats itself.
yarn-troppo.variety: Wide range of terms, but the device of an added lead-in tag repeats paragraph after paragraph: "Righto,", "Now for the good bit.", "Here's how it worked.", "Good news:", "Just don't mix it up", "Stuck?".
yarn-troppo.essence: Still recognisably the FOLD FAQ with its sections, code and links, but its dry reference character is replaced by a pitch-like walkthrough.
